latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – empowers users to make durable natural dyes from local plants, guided by an agent for all planning and chemistry.

- Guides users through safe identification, mordant calculations, and timeline management for home-based dye making.
- Splits roles clearly: agent handles plant ID, math, and reminders; human does all hands-on harvesting and dye work.
- Provides structured 21-day protocol, photo checkpoints, and fastness testing for reliable, repeatable dye results.
- Includes ready-to-use templates for field reports, dye batch logs, and barter/trade communications.
- Built-in safety protocols, inventory tracking, and progress dashboards foster self-reliance and trade-readiness.
